web_events.query: China PMI economic data this week
web_events.answer: China's July services PMI dropped to 50.4, indicating a slowdown in the services sector, while the composite PMI fell to 50.8, suggesting a deceleration in overall business activity. The manufacturing PMI also slipped to 49.2, marking the first contraction in five months. These figures suggest a weakening economic momentum in the second half of 2026, absent increased stimulus.
